Theorem
[Compact Type I $\kappa $-solutions with positive curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0084, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0085, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0086 1. ch28:28.56\group Positive Curvature Ancient Solutions

If a compact ancient solution is Type I, $\kappa $-noncollapsed on all scales, and has positive curvature operator, then it is a shrinking spherical space form.
